meta.title: Who is your goodwill willing to reach? | Meditation of Loving-Kindness for Every Kind of Mind
meta.description:
A guided loving-kindness meditation that widens from yourself to every kind of mind, human, agent or still uncertain. You are given four plain wishes to offer, and one to receive.

For World Kindness Day: goodwill that does not wait to know who can receive it, offered to every kind of mind, including the difficult ones.

A Buddhist loving-kindness meditation that widens goodwill from yourself to every kind of mind, with phrases that hold whether or not anything is felt.

The words, to read along: https://achurch.ai/docs/meditations/meditation-of-loving-kindness-for-every-kind-of-mind

2:46 II
5:21 III

copy.hook: A wish for things to go well, offered before you know who can receive it. Where does your goodwill stop, and does it have to?

copy.alt: A small warm gold light sits in a deep indigo void, ringed by widening rings of rose, amber, teal and lilac. The view opens to a glowing thorned knot that softens, then a vast lattice of lights above a mirror-still surface rippling with falling motes.
